Soil Fitness Landscape

Soil indicators as a fitness landscape, mirroring the Physiological Fitness Landscape: where soils sit (survey distributions), how each indicator scores against a function (scoring and yield-response curves), which practices move it (meta-analytic effects) and how it drifts (repeated surveys). Every number carries a citation; DOIs were checked against Crossref at build time.

Built 2026-10-08 from data/soil_landscape.db · seed catalogue v0.1 · Open Source Medicine. Tier A = published scoring function with parameters; B = published response model; C = curve drawn here from published thresholds (dashed).
